headline: Shimanto Bank offers jobs with BDT 50,000 salary, no prior experience required
summary: Shimanto Bank PLC has announced new job openings, offering a monthly salary of BDT 50,000. These positions are open to candidates without prior work experience, providing a significant opportunity for fresh graduates and job seekers.
details: Shimanto Bank PLC has opened new recruitment opportunities for individuals seeking employment in the banking sector. A notable aspect of these positions is the attractive monthly salary of BDT 50,000.
The bank is specifically looking for candidates who may not have prior work experience. This initiative aims to provide a pathway for fresh talent to enter the banking industry.

Further details regarding the application process, eligibility criteria, and specific roles are expected to be announced soon. Interested applicants should monitor official channels for updates on how to apply.
caption:
Looking for a job with a BDT 50,000 salary and no experience needed? Shimanto Bank PLC has announced new opportunities!

Further details regarding the application process, eligibility criteria, and specific roles are expected to be announced soon. Interested applicants should monitor official channels for updates on how to apply.
